items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1983-05-28
items.q: seems to me some of the other people on the Parisian room Sunday afternoon concerts were Cenk Monk Hazel Lester Bouchon.

ctx.x: Yeah I think he was. I don't remember him playing with Shark on a regular basis I just remember him at the Parisian room and maybe at some of the jazz club meetings too.

seems to me some of the other people on the Parisian room Sunday afternoon concerts were Cenk Monk Hazel Lester Bouchon. Uh huh. I mentioned Frank Federico already. Any piano player that you remember? Uh huh. Or singer? Don't know if I remember correctly that Lizzie Wells was there a couple of times or not. Probably not but I don't know.
She was there later on then. Uh huh. You can remember after that shocking phase. I didn't really go to the Parisian room later on.
